# Qlavo — White-label AI-search delivery for agencies

Qlavo is led by Ansh Bhatia in New Delhi, India. We prepare fixed-scope AI-search work behind an agency's brand. The agency keeps the client relationship, approves the work and handles publication. Public contact: info@qlavo.in.

## Current offer

White-label AI-search pilot: $750 USD one time for one client brand, site, market and language. Delivery is 10 business days after required inputs arrive; client delays pause delivery. Payment is $375 at kickoff and $375 on acceptance against the deliverable checklist. One revision is included.

Deliverables: five agreed buyer questions across two engines with two fresh runs each (20 observations per snapshot); a prioritized issue/source memo; one publish-ready buyer/use-case page improvement; implementation checklist; repeat checks and editable reporting at handoff. Optional ongoing work is separately agreed. No guaranteed recommendations, rankings, leads or outcome deadlines. No automatic retainer.
